recipes.title: Thai green curry with chicken
recipes.blurb: Creamy, herby coconut curry with tender chicken and veggies

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Fry the curry paste for 1 minute until fragrant, stirring.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir until smooth. Add fish sauce and sugar.
Add the chicken and simmer gently until cooked through, 165°F inside.
Add bamboo shoots and bell pepper. Simmer 5 more minutes.
Stir in the basil. Serve over hot jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai red curry with chicken
recipes.blurb: Classic red curry with bell pepper and bamboo shoots

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the curry paste 1 minute.
Stir in the coconut milk, fish sauce and brown sugar.
Add the chicken and simmer until cooked through, 165°F inside.
Add the pepper and bamboo shoots. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the basil and serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Massaman beef curry
recipes.blurb: Slow-simmered beef and potatoes in a mild, nutty curry

steps.text: Brown the beef in oil in a Dutch oven, in batches. Set aside.
Fry the curry paste in the same pot for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, onion, fish sauce, sugar, tamarind and beef. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer on low until the beef is nearly tender.
Add potatoes and peanuts. Cook until potatoes are tender.
Taste and adjust salt or sugar. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Panang beef curry
recipes.blurb: Thick, rich curry with thin-sliced beef and lime leaf

steps.text: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Fry curry paste 1 minute.
Stir in half the coconut milk and cook until oil separates, 3 minutes.
Add remaining coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar and lime leaves.
Add the beef and bell pepper. Simmer until beef is just cooked.
Serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai yellow curry with potatoes
recipes.blurb: Mild, golden curry with chicken, potato and onion

steps.text: Heat oil in a pot. Fry the curry paste 1 minute.
Stir in the coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar.
Add potatoes and onion. Simmer until potatoes begin to soften.
Add the chicken. Simmer until chicken reaches 165°F and potatoes are tender.
Serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Red curry with tofu and vegetables
recipes.blurb: Plant-based red curry loaded with veg

steps.text: Heat oil in a pot and fry the curry paste 1 minute.
Stir in coconut milk, soy sauce and sugar. Bring to a simmer.
Add tofu, pepper, broccoli and zucchini.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender but bright.
Stir in the lime juice and serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Red curry shrimp with pineapple
recipes.blurb: Sweet, spicy and ready in 20 minutes

steps.text: Heat oil in a pot and fry the curry paste 1 minute.
Stir in coconut milk, broth and fish sauce. Bring to a simmer.
Add pepper and pineapple. Simmer 3 minutes.
Add shrimp. Cook until pink and curled, 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in basil and serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Butternut squash coconut curry
recipes.blurb: Silky squash in a mild red curry sauce

steps.text: Fry the curry paste in oil for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, broth, soy sauce, sugar and squash.
Simmer, partly covered, until the squash is tender.
Add chickpeas and spinach. Cook until spinach wilts, 2 minutes.
Serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Vietnamese chicken curry (ca ri ga)
recipes.blurb: Lemongrass chicken, carrots and potatoes in coconut curry

steps.text: Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Brown the chicken skin-side down, 5 minutes per side.
Add lemongrass, garlic and curry powder. Stir 1 minute.
Pour in broth, coconut milk and fish sauce. Bring to a simmer.
Add carrots and potatoes. Simmer covered until chicken hits 175°F and vegetables are tender.
Remove lemongrass. Serve with baguette or rice.

recipes.title: Chicken pad Thai
recipes.blurb: The takeout favorite, made at home

steps.text: Soak the noodles in hot water until pliable but firm.
Whisk the tamarind, fish sauce and sugar together.
Heat oil in a wok on high. Cook the chicken until 165°F inside. Add garlic.
Push chicken aside. Scramble the eggs, then mix in.
Add drained noodles and sauce. Toss until the noodles are tender.
Add sprouts and green onions. Serve with peanuts and lime.

recipes.title: Vegetarian pad Thai with tofu
recipes.blurb: Tofu, sprouts and peanuts in tangy tamarind sauce

steps.text: Soak the noodles in hot water until pliable.
Whisk tamarind, soy sauce and sugar together.
Fry tofu in oil in a wok until golden, 5 minutes. Add garlic.
Push tofu aside and scramble the eggs.
Add noodles and sauce. Toss until tender, 2 to 3 minutes.
Fold in sprouts and green onions. Top with peanuts and lime.

recipes.title: Pad see ew
recipes.blurb: Wide rice noodles with broccolini in sweet soy

steps.text: Cook or soak the noodles per package until just tender. Drain.
Mix dark soy, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and pepper.
Heat oil in a wok on high. Cook chicken until 165°F inside. Add garlic.
Push aside and scramble the eggs. Add broccolini and a splash of water.
Add noodles and sauce. Toss until the noodles char lightly.

recipes.title: Drunken noodles (pad kee mao)
recipes.blurb: Spicy wide noodles with basil and chilies

steps.text: Cook or soak the noodles until just tender. Drain.
Mix oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar.
Heat oil in a wok on high. Stir-fry garlic and chilies 20 seconds.
Add chicken. Cook until 165°F inside, breaking it up.
Add onion and pepper for 2 minutes, then noodles and sauce. Toss.
Stir in basil until wilted.

recipes.title: Khao soi chicken noodle curry
recipes.blurb: Northern Thai coconut curry noodle soup

steps.text: Fry the curry paste and curry powder in oil 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, broth, fish sauce, sugar and chicken. Bring to a simmer.
Simmer until the chicken hits 175°F.
Pull chicken off the bone and shred. Return to the pot.
Boil the noodles until tender. Drain and divide among bowls.
Ladle the curry over noodles. Top with shallots, green onions and lime.

recipes.title: Thai peanut noodles
recipes.blurb: Cold or warm noodles in creamy peanut sauce

steps.text: Boil the noodles until tender. Drain and rinse in cool water.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, sesame oil and sriracha.
Add ginger, garlic and 3 tbsp hot water to loosen the sauce.
Toss noodles with the sauce.
Top with carrots, cucumber and peanuts.

recipes.title: Grilled pork vermicelli bowls (bun thit nuong)
recipes.blurb: Lemongrass pork over cool noodles and herbs

steps.text: Mix pork with lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and oil. Marinate.
Whisk nuoc cham: fish sauce, sugar, lime juice and water.
Cook the vermicelli per package. Rinse cold and drain.
Grill or pan-sear pork on high until browned and 145°F inside.
Divide lettuce, noodles, cucumber, carrot and herbs among bowls.
Top with pork and peanuts. Spoon nuoc cham over.

recipes.title: Lemongrass beef noodle bowls (bun bo xao)
recipes.blurb: Quick stir-fried beef over cool vermicelli

steps.text: Toss beef with lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce and sugar. Rest.
Whisk nuoc cham: fish sauce, sugar, lime juice and water.
Cook vermicelli per package. Rinse cold and drain.
Sear beef and onion in hot oil in batches, 2 minutes each.
Layer lettuce, noodles, cucumber and mint in bowls.
Top with beef. Spoon nuoc cham over.

recipes.title: Rad na chicken gravy noodles
recipes.blurb: Pan-fried noodles under a silky ginger gravy

steps.text: Cook the noodles until tender. Drain well.
Pan-fry noodles in 2 tbsp oil until browned in spots. Set on plates.
Cook chicken in remaining oil until 165°F inside. Add garlic and ginger.
Add broth, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and broccolini. Simmer.
Stir in cornstarch slurry until thick. Pour over noodles.

recipes.title: Pad kra pao (Thai basil chicken)
recipes.blurb: Fiery garlic-chili chicken with basil, the street food classic

steps.text: Mix oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar.
Heat oil in a wok on high. Fry garlic and chilies 20 seconds.
Add chicken and cook until 165°F inside, breaking it up.
Add the bell pepper and sauce. Toss 1 minute.
Turn off the heat. Stir in the basil.
Serve over rice with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Thai cashew chicken
recipes.blurb: Sweet-savory chicken with toasted cashews and chili

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok on high. Cook chicken until golden, 4 minutes.
Add onion, pepper and garlic. Cook 2 minutes.
Add oyster sauce, soy sauce and sugar. Toss until chicken is 165°F inside.
Stir in cashews and green onions. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Ginger chicken stir-fry (pad king)
recipes.blurb: Lots of fresh ginger, mushrooms and onion

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok on high. Sear the chicken until golden, 4 minutes.
Add ginger and garlic. Stir 30 seconds.
Add mushrooms and onion. Cook until softened, 3 minutes.
Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and a splash of water. Check chicken is 165°F.
Toss in green onions. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Pad pak ruam (mixed vegetable tofu stir-fry)
recipes.blurb: Colorful veggies and tofu in garlic sauce

steps.text: Brown the tofu in oil in a wok on high, 5 minutes. Remove.
Stir-fry garlic, broccoli and carrots 3 minutes.
Add snap peas and baby corn. Cook 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, water and tofu. Toss 1 minute.
Serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Garlic pepper pork (moo tod gratiem)
recipes.blurb: Crispy-edged pork with loads of garlic and black pepper

steps.text: Toss the pork with half the garlic, the pepper, soy sauce and sugar.
Heat oil in a wok on high. Add pork in a single layer.
Cook until browned and 145°F inside, 4 minutes.
Add remaining garlic and oyster sauce. Toss 30 seconds.
Serve over rice with cucumber.

recipes.title: Thai beef and broccoli
recipes.blurb: Tender sirloin and crisp broccoli in a garlicky sauce

steps.text: Whisk oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, water and cornstarch.
Sear beef in hot oil in two batches, 2 minutes each. Remove.
Cook broccoli and garlic with a splash of water until bright, 3 minutes.
Return the beef. Pour in the sauce and toss until glossy.
Serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Vietnamese lemongrass chicken (ga xao sa ot)
recipes.blurb: Fragrant lemongrass and chili chicken

steps.text: Toss chicken with lemongrass, garlic, chilies, fish sauce and sugar.
Marinate at room temperature.
Heat oil in a wok on high. Cook onion 2 minutes.
Add the chicken. Cook until browned and 165°F inside.
Top with green onions. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Shaking beef (bo luc lac)
recipes.blurb: Seared beef cubes with garlic butter over greens

steps.text: Marinate beef with soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and half the garlic.
Heat oil in a skillet on very high. Sear beef in two batches.
Shake the pan; cook 2 minutes per batch for medium.
Add butter and remaining garlic. Toss 30 seconds.
Mix greens, onion, lime juice and pepper. Top with beef.

recipes.title: Thai chili garlic shrimp
recipes.blurb: Plump shrimp in spicy garlic sauce with green beans

steps.text: Mix sambal, fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar and lime juice.
Heat oil in a wok on high. Stir-fry green beans 3 minutes.
Add garlic and shrimp. Cook until pink, 3 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and toss 1 minute.
Serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Beef pho (pho bo)
recipes.blurb: Star anise broth, rice noodles and rare beef

steps.text: Boil the bones 5 minutes, then drain and rinse well.
Char the onion and ginger under the broiler until blackened.
Add bones, onion, ginger, water and spices to a pot. Simmer gently, skimming.
Strain the broth. Season with fish sauce, sugar and salt.
Cook noodles per package. Divide among bowls.
Top with raw beef and ladle boiling broth over. Add sprouts, herbs and lime.

recipes.title: Chicken pho (pho ga)
recipes.blurb: Lighter, quicker pho with a clear ginger broth

steps.text: Char the onion and ginger under the broiler until blackened.
Add chicken, onion, ginger, water and spices to a pot. Bring to a boil, then lower to a simmer.
Simmer until the chicken reaches 165°F, skimming foam.
Remove chicken and shred the meat. Strain the broth and season with fish sauce, sugar, salt.
Cook noodles per package and divide among bowls.
Add chicken, ladle hot broth over. Top with sprouts, green onions, cilantro, lime.

recipes.title: Vegetarian pho
recipes.blurb: Mushroom and spice broth with tofu and rice noodles

steps.text: Char the onion and ginger under the broiler until blackened.
Simmer onion, ginger, broth, water, mushrooms, star anise and cinnamon.
Strain. Season with soy sauce and sugar; keep hot.
Cook noodles per package and divide among bowls.
Add tofu, ladle broth over, and top with sprouts, basil and lime.

recipes.title: Tom yum goong (hot and sour shrimp soup)
recipes.blurb: Lemongrass, galangal and lime in a bright, spicy broth

steps.text: Bring broth, lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves to a boil.
Simmer to infuse.
Add mushrooms and chili paste. Cook 3 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, 3 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in fish sauce, lime juice and chilies.
Top with cilantro. Do not eat the lemongrass pieces.

recipes.title: Tom kha gai (coconut chicken soup)
recipes.blurb: Creamy, tangy coconut soup with mushrooms

steps.text: Simmer broth, coconut milk, lemongrass and galangal.
Add chicken and mushrooms. Simmer until chicken is 165°F inside.
Stir in fish sauce and sugar.
Off the heat, add lime juice and chilies.
Top with cilantro. Do not eat the lemongrass pieces.

recipes.title: Khao tom (Thai chicken rice soup)
recipes.blurb: Cozy ginger rice porridge with chicken

steps.text: Fry garlic in oil until golden, 2 minutes. Set aside for topping.
Simmer broth, rice and ginger until the rice is very soft.
Add chicken and simmer until 165°F inside.
Stir in fish sauce and white pepper.
Top with fried garlic, green onions and cilantro.

recipes.title: Canh chua (Vietnamese sour shrimp soup)
recipes.blurb: Tangy tamarind soup with tomato and pineapple

steps.text: Fry the garlic in oil 30 seconds in a pot.
Add broth, tamarind and pineapple with juice. Bring to a boil.
Add tomatoes and celery. Simmer 5 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, 3 minutes.
Stir in fish sauce, sugar, sprouts and cilantro. Taste and adjust.

recipes.title: Bo kho (Vietnamese beef stew)
recipes.blurb: Lemongrass and star anise beef stew with carrots

steps.text: Brown the beef in oil in a Dutch oven, in batches. Set aside.
Cook onion, garlic and lemongrass 3 minutes. Add tomato paste, curry powder and star anise.
Return the beef. Add broth and fish sauce. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer on low until the beef is nearly tender.
Add carrots. Cook until tender and the sauce thickens.
Serve with baguette or over rice noodles.

recipes.title: Thai tofu and glass noodle soup (gaeng jued)
recipes.blurb: Clear garlicky broth, soft tofu and greens

steps.text: Soak the glass noodles in hot water until soft, then drain and cut.
Fry garlic in oil in a pot until golden, 1 minute.
Add broth and carrots. Simmer until carrots soften.
Add cabbage, tofu and noodles. Simmer 3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and pepper. Top with green onions.

recipes.title: Shrimp summer rolls (goi cuon)
recipes.blurb: Fresh rice paper rolls with shrimp, herbs and peanut dip

steps.text: Boil the shrimp until pink, then cool and halve lengthwise.
Cook the vermicelli per package. Rinse cold and drain.
Whisk hoisin, peanut butter and water for the dip.
Dip one wrapper in warm water for 10 seconds until barely soft.
Layer lettuce, noodles, veggies, herbs and 4 shrimp halves. Fold in sides and roll tight.
Repeat with remaining wrappers. Serve with dip.

recipes.title: Tofu summer rolls
recipes.blurb: Crisp tofu and veggie rolls with sweet chili dip

steps.text: Toss tofu sticks with soy sauce. Pan-fry in oil until golden on all sides.
Cook the vermicelli per package. Rinse cold and drain.
Dip one wrapper in warm water for 10 seconds until barely soft.
Layer lettuce, noodles, tofu, veggies and herbs. Fold in sides and roll tight.
Repeat with the rest. Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.title: Vietnamese fried spring rolls (cha gio)
recipes.blurb: Crispy rolls of pork, shrimp and glass noodles

steps.text: Mix pork, shrimp, noodles, carrot, green onions, garlic, fish sauce, pepper and egg.
Dip a wrapper in warm water and lay flat. Add 2 tbsp filling.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Repeat with the rest.
Heat oil to 350°F in a deep skillet.
Fry rolls in batches until golden and pork reaches 160°F, about 6 minutes.
Drain on a rack. Wrap in lettuce with mint and dip in fish sauce.

recipes.title: Green papaya salad (som tam)
recipes.blurb: Crunchy, spicy, sour and sweet pounded salad

steps.text: Pound the garlic and chilies in a mortar, or mince them finely.
Mix in lime juice, fish sauce and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Add green beans and bruise lightly with a spoon.
Toss in papaya and tomatoes. Taste for sweet, sour and heat.
Top with peanuts and serve right away.

recipes.title: Larb gai (chicken salad with mint)
recipes.blurb: Zesty minced chicken with toasted rice powder

steps.text: Toast the rice in a dry skillet until deep golden, then grind to a coarse powder.
Cook the chicken in a splash of water until 165°F, breaking it up.
Take off the heat. Stir in lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and pepper flakes.
Mix in shallots, green onions, herbs and rice powder.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

recipes.title: Thai grilled beef salad (yum nuea)
recipes.blurb: Seared steak with cucumber, tomato and a lime-chili dressing

steps.text: Season steak with pepper. Grill or sear on high for 4 minutes per side for medium (135°F).
Rest the steak before slicing.
Whisk lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, chilies and garlic.
Slice the steak thin against the grain.
Toss with cucumber, tomatoes, onion, mint, lettuce and dressing.

recipes.title: Glass noodle salad with shrimp (yum woon sen)
recipes.blurb: Slippery noodles, shrimp and pork in a spicy lime dressing

steps.text: Soak the glass noodles in hot water until soft. Drain and cut short.
Cook pork and shrimp in a little water until pork is 160°F and shrimp are pink.
Whisk lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chilies.
Toss noodles, meat, tomato, onion, green onions and dressing.
Top with cilantro and peanuts.

recipes.title: Vietnamese chicken cabbage salad (goi ga)
recipes.blurb: Shredded chicken, cabbage and herbs in nuoc cham

steps.text: Poach the chicken in simmering water until 165°F inside.
Cool and shred the chicken.
Whisk fish sauce, lime juice, sugar and chili until sugar dissolves.
Toss the cabbage, carrots, onion and herbs with the chicken.
Add the dressing and toss. Top with peanuts.

recipes.title: Thai cucumber salad
recipes.blurb: Cool, sweet-sour cucumbers with shallot and peanuts

steps.text: Warm vinegar, sugar and salt, stirring until dissolved. Cool.
Combine cucumbers, shallots and chili in a bowl.
Pour the dressing over and toss.
Chill before serving.
Top with cilantro and peanuts.

recipes.title: Crunchy Thai peanut slaw
recipes.blurb: Cabbage, carrot and edamame in a peanut-lime dressing

steps.text: Whisk peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, honey and sesame oil. Thin with water.
Toss the cabbages, carrots, edamame and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the dressing and cilantro. Toss to coat.
Let it sit to soften slightly.
Top with peanuts.

recipes.title: Thai chicken fried rice (khao pad gai)
recipes.blurb: Day-old rice, egg and chicken with a lime squeeze

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok on high. Cook the chicken until 165°F inside.
Add garlic and onion. Cook 2 minutes.
Push aside. Add 1 tbsp oil and scramble the eggs.
Add rice and break up clumps. Fry until hot and lightly toasted.
Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce and sugar. Toss.
Top with green onions. Serve with lime and cucumber.

recipes.title: Pineapple fried rice
recipes.blurb: Sweet pineapple, cashews and shrimp in curry-scented rice

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok on high. Cook shrimp until pink, 3 minutes. Remove.
Add 1 tbsp oil, garlic, onion and bell pepper. Cook 3 minutes.
Add rice and curry powder. Fry until hot.
Add pineapple, soy sauce and fish sauce. Toss.
Return the shrimp. Top with cashews and green onions.

recipes.title: Thai basil fried rice
recipes.blurb: Spicy fried rice with chicken, chilies and holy basil

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok on high. Fry garlic and chilies 20 seconds.
Add chicken. Cook until 165°F inside, breaking it up.
Add bell pepper and rice. Fry until hot.
Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar. Toss.
Turn off heat, stir in basil. Top with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Khao man gai (Thai chicken and rice)
recipes.blurb: Poached chicken over ginger-garlic rice with dipping sauce

steps.text: Simmer the chicken, half the ginger and the water in a pot, covered, until chicken hits 175°F.
Remove chicken. Save and strain the cooking broth.
Fry rice, garlic and remaining ginger in oil for 2 minutes.
Add 3 cups hot broth and salt. Cover and cook on low until tender.
Whisk soy sauce, vinegar, sriracha and 2 tbsp broth for the sauce.
Slice the chicken. Serve over rice with cucumber, cilantro and sauce.

recipes.title: Grilled pork rice plate (com tam)
recipes.blurb: Lemongrass pork chops over rice with pickles and egg

ingredients.note: or fish sauce mixed with lime

steps.text: Marinate pork with lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and oil.
Cook the rice per package directions.
Grill or pan-sear the pork until browned and 145°F inside, 4 minutes per side.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Plate rice, pork, egg, cucumber and tomato. Spoon sauce over.

recipes.title: Banh mi rice bowls
recipes.blurb: Pork, quick pickles, cucumber and cilantro over rice

steps.text: Toss carrots with vinegar and sugar. Let them pickle.
Heat oil in a skillet. Cook pork with garlic until 160°F, breaking it up.
Add soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar. Cook 1 minute.
Mix mayonnaise and sriracha.
Divide rice into bowls. Top with pork, pickles, cucumber, jalapeño and cilantro.
Drizzle with the sriracha mayo.

recipes.title: Thai omelet over rice (khai jiao)
recipes.blurb: Crispy, puffy omelet with sweet chili sauce

steps.text: Whisk eggs with fish sauce, lime juice and pepper.
Heat the oil in a wok until shimmering, about 350°F.
Pour in a quarter of the eggs from high up. Fry until puffed and golden, 1 minute.
Flip, cook 30 seconds, and drain. Repeat for 4 omelets.
Put each over rice. Top with chili sauce and green onions.

recipes.title: Thai vegetable tofu fried rice
recipes.blurb: Wok rice with crispy tofu, broccoli and egg

steps.text: Fry the tofu in 2 tbsp oil until golden, 6 minutes. Remove.
Cook garlic, onion, broccoli and carrot 4 minutes.
Push aside. Add 1 tbsp oil and scramble the eggs.
Add rice, tofu, soy sauce, sugar and pepper. Fry until hot.
Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken satay rice bowls
recipes.blurb: Turmeric grilled chicken skewers with peanut sauce

steps.text: Mix half the coconut milk with turmeric, curry powder, soy sauce and sugar. Add the chicken.
Marinate in the fridge.
Cook the rice per package directions.
Thread the chicken on skewers. Grill or broil until 165°F inside, 5 minutes per side.
Whisk the rest of the coconut milk with peanut butter, lime juice and sriracha. Warm gently.
Serve chicken over rice with cucumber, carrot and peanut sauce.
